id: title:Gilbert09:find connectors by their former names in search

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion source discovery keywords for Twitter/X and Zendesk Sell, supporting warehouse users searching by rebranded names.
review.reason: Adds two hunks: P1.F1.H1 adds 'x' and 'x.com' keywords for the Twitter warehouse source; P1.F2.H1 adds 'base crm' and 'base' keywords for the Zendesk Sell warehouse source. These are narrow, localized maintenance changes to warehouse ingestion metadata, not systemic improvements.
review.uncertainty: No evidence of actual adoption, incident avoidance, or broader systemic benefit; score relies solely on the presence of keyword additions.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds Twitter/X keyword support. P1.F2.H1 adds Zendesk Sell/Base CRM keyword support. No relationship between these two unrelated source additions is established. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 'x' and 'x.com' to the search keywords for the Twitter data warehouse source, while retaining the original 'Twitter' label.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse users to discover and select the Twitter source when searching by the rebranded name 'X' or domain 'x.com', rather than only the legacy name 'Twitter'. This supports the warehouse ingestion workflow for users following the rebrand.

observations.behavior: Adds 'base crm' and 'base' to the search keywords for the Zendesk Sell data warehouse source, while retaining the original 'Zendesk Sell' label.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse users to discover and select the Zendesk Sell source when searching by the former name 'Base CRM' or the short name 'base', supporting users transitioning from the Base CRM brand to Zendesk Sell.
